help.DEAD_EPISODE: Commanded actions are constant. Drop the episode; it teaches the policy to do nothing.
help.STATE_FROZEN: State never updates while actions change. Check the follower arm connection; drop the episode.
help.NONFINITE_VALUES: NaN/inf values break training. Drop or repair the affected frames.
help.DROPPED_FRAMES: Timestamp gaps mean frames were lost (USB bandwidth, CPU load). Actions and video desync around gaps.
help.TIMESTAMP_NONMONOTONIC: Timestamps go backwards or repeat. Recording clock or merge bug.
help.TIMESTAMP_JITTER: Irregular frame timing. Check camera/USB load during recording.
help.TIMESTAMP_DRIFT: Recording ran faster/slower than the declared fps.
help.FRAME_INDEX_DUPLICATE: Repeated frame_index values; usually a bad merge.
help.ACTION_SPIKE: Single-step jumps far larger than normal motion: teleop glitches or bus errors. Smooth or trim.
help.IDLE_PADDING: Long idle lead-in/tail. Trim it; idle frames bias policies toward hesitating.
help.GRIPPER_NEVER_ACTUATES: Gripper never moves. Fine for pushing tasks; a red flag for pick-and-place.
help.JOINT_AT_LIMIT: The operator pushes a joint into its hard stop mid-task; the arm cannot follow the command.
help.CALIBRATION_OFFSET: Leader and follower calibrations disagree near a joint limit. Usually harmless; recalibrate to be sure.
help.EPISODE_TOO_SHORT: Under a second long: almost always a false start. Drop it.
help.EPISODE_SHORT: Much shorter than typical: possibly truncated.
help.EPISODE_LONG: Much longer than typical: recording may not have been stopped.
help.EPISODE_LENGTH_MISMATCH: Episode metadata disagrees with the data. Indexes into this episode will be wrong.
help.DUPLICATE_EPISODE: Nearly identical to another episode: duplicated upload or replay. Inflates the dataset without adding information.
help.VIDEO_MISSING: Camera file missing; the episode cannot be loaded with images.
help.VIDEO_LENGTH_MISMATCH: Video and action streams have different lengths: they are out of sync.
help.VIDEO_SEGMENT_OUT_OF_RANGE: Episode points past the end of its video file.
help.VIDEO_BLACK: Camera shows black frames: lens cap, disconnect, or no light.
help.VIDEO_OVEREXPOSED: Camera is blown out: fix exposure or lighting.
help.VIDEO_FROZEN: Camera image never changes while the robot moves: stale or frozen feed.
help.VIDEO_FPS_MISMATCH: Camera frame rate differs from the dataset fps.
help.VIDEO_SHAPE_MISMATCH: Camera resolution differs from what info.json declares.
help.EPISODE_COUNT_MISMATCH: info.json disagrees with the data about how many episodes exist.
help.FRAME_COUNT_MISMATCH: info.json disagrees with the data about how many frames exist.
help.FEATURE_MISSING: A declared feature is absent from the data.
help.TASK_VAGUE: Task descriptions too vague to condition a language-conditioned (VLA) policy.
help.TASK_INDEX_UNKNOWN: Frames reference tasks that do not exist.
help.EPISODE_TASK_EMPTY: Episode has no task description, so it cannot train a language-conditioned policy.
help.GLOBAL_INDEX_DUPLICATES: Frames share global indices: data from different recordings was merged under the same numbers.
help.GLOBAL_INDEX_GAPS: Global frame indices skip values: frames or episodes are missing.
help.EPISODE_INDEX_GAPS: Episode numbers skip values: episodes were deleted or never uploaded.
help.TIMESTAMP_OFFSET: Episode timestamps do not start at 0.
help.TIMESTAMP_NONFINITE: Timestamps contain NaN or infinite values.
help.NO_ACTIONS: No action column: the dataset cannot train a policy.
help.NO_TIMESTAMPS: No timestamp column: timing cannot be verified.
help.PARTIAL_CHECK: Quick mode: only part of the dataset was checked.
